correctness.rationale: Exact matrix identities yield primitive-vector periods modulo every power of two; the Fibonacci doubling recurrence proves ν₂(F₆ₜ)=3+ν₂(t), hence exact projective zero spacing. The twelve-case mod-eight quadratic table partitions zero-bearing directions; cardinality-preserving projective lifting extends it to every higher dyadic level. Counting primitive directions and common depths gives the universal closed form. Exhaustive orbit verification through modulus 512, including all small cases, agrees but is not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The paper-defined zero-avoidance problem naturally asks for composite moduli; distinguishing zero from nonunit is essential here. The finding supplies an all-level mod-eight decision procedure, a universal positive proportion and complete orbit decomposition of all initial states—information absent from standard Pisano period/rank descriptions. These are a structural classification and exact natural counting invariant, not merely finite pattern matching.
